faq.question: What does Putra mean?
faq.answer: Putra is associated with the Sanskrit form بُوتْرَا, whose core sense is putra; son (sanskrit).

faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Putra an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Putra can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
